attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Nursing (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by the ANCC or another nationally certifying organization recognized by the Board, related to the certificate holder's specialty
rules.alternatives: Renewal also requires current national certification or recertification (ANCC or another Board-approved certifying body) and a current DC RN license.
rules.notes: 15 hours must include a pharmacology component (hours not set). The BON page also requires 2 h LGBTQ cultural competency and 10% public health priority topics; these may overlap the RN hours. The 2026 RN/APRN renewal notice is a scanned PDF and was not machine-readable.
